title: Best Contiguous Stretch
description:
You are given a list of integers, which may be negative. Find the largest possible sum of a non-empty run of consecutive elements and print that sum.

Input format
Line 1: n, the number of integers.
Line 2: n space-separated integers.

Output format
One integer: the maximum sum of a non-empty contiguous run.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 200000. Each value is between -1000000 and 1000000; the answer fits in a 64-bit signed integer.
hints: Trying every start and end is too slow for 200000 values. Can you decide, one element at a time, whether to extend the current run or start a new one?
At each position keep the best sum of a run that ends exactly there: either the element alone, or the element added to the best run ending just before it.
Track best_ending_here = max(x, best_ending_here + x) and best_overall = max(best_overall, best_ending_here). Start both from the first element, not from zero, so an all-negative list works.

examples.explanation: The run must not be empty, so the best choice is the single value -2.
